categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Sprint Precision Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of precision metal components for semiconductor equipment, focusing on key parts for etching and thin film deposition equipment. The company also extends its precision manufacturing capabilities to other sectors such as medical devices, photovoltaic equipment, and module products. Its product portfolio includes process components like chambers, liners, heaters, gas distribution plates, and structural components, as well as assembly modules and surface treatment services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision mechanical manufacturing, surface treatment, welding technologies, high-end device design and development, and customized tooling development. Key production methods include ultra-precision cutting, anodizing, chemical nickel plating, vacuum brazing, electron beam welding, and friction stir welding. It emphasizes high precision control, flexible manufacturing, and micro-hole processing to meet stringent semiconductor equipment standards, supporting advanced process nodes down to 7nm and below.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Its primary customers are leading domestic semiconductor equipment manufacturers such as Zhongwei Semiconductor, North Microelectronics, Tuojing Technology, Huahai Qingke, SMIC, and Yitang Technology. The company serves the semiconductor manufacturing industry, particularly the upstream semiconductor equipment sector, with products critical to wafer fabrication processes. It also serves other markets including medical equipment and photovoltaic industries, though semiconductor remains the dominant market.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates within mainland China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Jiangsu Province, including subsidiaries in Jingjiang and Wuxi. It also has a sales subsidiary in Singapore. The majority of its revenue is generated from the Chinese domestic market, with limited sales outside China primarily in medical device components.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Sprint Precision Technologies operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in the production of critical precision metal components used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. It supplies core parts to semiconductor equipment manufacturers, who then integrate these components into their systems for wafer fabrication.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes deepening its technological capabilities in precision manufacturing, surface treatment, welding, and high-end device design to support advanced semiconductor process nodes. It focuses on R&D to enhance product performance, expand product categories, and improve production efficiency. Strategic R&D initiatives include developing advanced process components, surface treatment technologies for high cleanliness and corrosion resistance, and expanding into new precision manufacturing fields such as medical and photovoltaic sectors. The company also emphasizes collaboration with customers for joint development and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision metal components and modules to semiconductor equipment manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company follows a direct sales model, negotiating prices based on production costs, market conditions, and target profits. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on product sales and related manufacturing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of precision metal components for semiconductor equipment, recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' small giant enterprise. It competes with international suppliers from the US, Japan, and Europe, especially in advanced process components. Domestically, it collaborates closely with top semiconductor equipment manufacturers and holds a significant market share in etching and thin film deposition equipment components. The industry is fragmented with high technical barriers, and the company maintains competitive advantages through technology and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.136 billion, representing a 103.65% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 213.95 million, a 166.52% increase. Total assets reached RMB 1.978 billion, up 84.72%, and net assets attributable to shareholders nearly doubled to RMB 1.482 billion. The company has shown rapid growth driven by the semiconductor industry's recovery and domestic substitution trends. R&D investment increased by 76.49% to RMB 64 million, accounting for 5.64% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological innovation and precision manufacturing capabilities as core competitive advantages. It offers highly specialized, customized precision metal components with stringent quality, cleanliness, and performance standards critical for advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its differentiated value lies in its ability to supply key process components for advanced nodes (7nm and below), its flexible manufacturing system for small batch, multi-variety production, and its close collaboration with leading domestic semiconductor equipment manufacturers to support their product development and iteration. The company also leverages its patented technologies and comprehensive quality management to ensure product reliability and customer satisfaction.
